To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have identified for the first time, 6 DEPs that have distinct reproductive functions and are expressed only in 2 or 3 of the ROS groups and not in the control, which can serve as potential markers of ROS-induced male infertility.
we have for the first first time identified 6 DEPs in spermatozoal proteins from infertile men that are distinct to each ROS group.
we have identified 6 DEPs in sperm that are unique to men with low, moderate or high levels of ROS.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and analysis of DEPs in spermatozoal proteins in infertile men with low, intermediate and high levels of reactive oxygen.
the identification and characterization of DEPs in the spermatozoa of infertile patients with low, intermediate and high ROS levels.
the identification of DEPs that are involved in oxidative stress induced male factor infertility.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
precise modulation of ROS levels in infertile men can have a profound effect on the differential expression patterns of proteins in the spermatozoa.
the precise modulation of the ROS levels in infertile men can have a significant impact on DEPs in spermatozoal proteins.
the DEPs identified are potential biomarkers of ROS induced male infertility.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
precise modulation of ROS levels in spermatozoal proteins can be a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of male infertility.
ROS levels can modulate the expression of sperm proteins that are involved in male infertility.
ROS levels can modulate protein expression in spermatozoal cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ROS levels in the ejaculate have a significant impact on the spermatozoa proteome and this can be exploited for the diagnosis and treatment of male infertility.
ROS levels can be precisely modulated to induce differential expression of specific proteins that are involved in male infertility.
ROS levels can modulate the expression of specific proteins in the spermatozoa and these proteins can be utilized as biomarkers of oxidative induced male infertility.
